extracted.name: French fries 🍟
instruction_lines: First par boil potatoes.let it cool
Cut french fries, now mix Red chili powder, cinnamon powder,dry mango powder,salt,keep aside
Take big bowl add french fries, pour mixture of masala,add honey rest for ten minutes
Now add corn flour, add all-purpose flour (you can skip this I am making instant so I added)
Put it in hot oil fry till golden brown serve with tomato sauce 😋😋, really tastes yum.
